audit_items.proof_trace: Both handle_borrow (L424) and handle_withdraw (L332) call is_obligation_safe, which calls get_price_with_check for every debt and collateral asset in the obligation, asserting |ema_price - spot_price| / spot_price <= per-asset tolerance before any state change is committed. The liquidation paths (liquidation_inner, ensure_liquidate_borrow_allowed, liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens) use get_price (EMA-only) and get_spot_price without the tolerance check, which is intentional design to permit liquidation even during price volatility.
